compatibility_constraints.gradio-pillow: Gradio 6.32 resolves with Pillow 12.3 on Python 3.10 or Pillow 13 on Python >=3.11; frontend qualification is separate
compatibility_constraints.directml-numerical: Legacy Torch 2.4 / NumPy 1.x / SciPy / OpenCV / rembg require complete closure
compatibility_constraints.legacy-core-api: Torch below core API floor needs an independently qualified explicit exception
compatibility_constraints.old-torch-transformers-kornia: Legacy pins cannot bypass native API or transitive Torch floors

optional_environments: native llama.cpp and its ROCm libraries
optional_main_extension: xllamacpp; hash-locked closure, no imported backend replacement
